reviews.body:
Good sweep, thanks. Sending an output limit of `0` from a hand-written config is a quiet way to get errors or empty answers, and routing the six remaining backends through `maxTokensOrDefault` gives every backend the same default.

I read the full diff: each change is the one-line `Configure` swap, configured values are untouched, and the new tests check the request for Bedrock Converse and Cohere and the stored value for SageMaker and Google GenAI. Build, tests and `validate` are green at `e30fb78`.

#1904 edits the lines next to yours in `CohereClient.Configure`, so whichever lands second may need a quick rebase. Good to merge.
